sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
probePurpose: Record public, non-credentialed access-route evidence for the NHATS Colectica value-label capture workflow without storing credentials, account identity, raw Colectica metadata, row-level NHATS data or restricted materials.

currentDecision.reason: The official public entry point, portal login boundary and technical guide route are verified, but no Colectica account, authenticated variable pages, values/value labels, question text, universe/skip logic or export artifacts have been captured.

sourceEvidence.evidenceUse: Official NHATS entry point identifying Colectica as the cross-year metadata route.
Anonymous root access redirects to the login page and proves public unauthenticated browsing is insufficient for variable capture.
Anonymous search request resolves to the login page, so route field value labels cannot be collected by unauthenticated public scraping.
Official NHATS guide describing Colectica account creation, Explore, Search, Details and Basket export workflow.

anonymousAccessProbe.methodBoundary: Public non-credentialed HTTP probes only. No account credentials, no session cookies, no authenticated metadata capture and no raw NHATS data are stored.

rootHeadNoFollow.interpretation: Root portal access requires login before authenticated metadata browsing.

rootGetFollow.interpretation: Unauthenticated browser-equivalent access lands on login page.

searchGetFollow.interpretation: Unauthenticated variable search does not expose route-field metadata.

latestAnonymousLiveReprobe.methodBoundary: Public non-credentialed GET probes only. No account credentials, no session cookies, no authenticated metadata capture, no raw Colectica export and no raw NHATS data are stored.

observations.interpretation: Anonymous portal root access still lands on the login page.
Anonymous search for a route-field candidate still lands on the login page and exposes no variable details.
The official NHATS Cross-Year Search page remains publicly reachable and points users toward the Colectica workflow.

latestTechnicalGuideFreshnessProbe.methodBoundary: Public non-credentialed HTTP/PDF freshness probe only. The PDF was downloaded to temporary local storage for hash verification and is not committed to the repository.

publicGuideFacts: Create an account before using Colectica.
Explore page allows section-level variable review across rounds.
Search page can find variables, questions and data files.
Variable details pages contain question name, label, data file, possible values, value labels, question text and concordance information.
Basket contents can be downloaded after login in PDF, CSV, Excel or DDI 3.2 XML format.
technicalGuideRoute.captureImplication: The next real evidence must be authenticated page captures or authenticated basket exports with source hashes stored outside public raw-data exposure.

captureSequence.action: Create or use a controlled NHATS Colectica account outside the public repository.
requiredEvidence: reviewer identity boundary recorded outside public repo
captureSequence.repoAllowed: Only status, date and non-sensitive review notes.
captureSequence.repoForbidden: Credentials, session cookies, account profile details.

captureSequence.action: Use Colectica Search or Explore for each required route field candidate.
requiredEvidence: variable page URL or stable item identifier
captureSequence.repoForbidden: Bulk raw metadata dumps or any row-level NHATS data.

captureSequence.action: Open each variable Details page or authenticated basket export.
captureSequence.repoAllowed: Minimal reviewed field/value crosswalk needed for route classifier design, subject to NHATS conditions and disclosure constraints.
captureSequence.repoForbidden: Unreviewed public AI upload, unrestricted raw exports, sensitive death dates.

captureSequence.action: Perform second reviewer signoff before route classifier promotion.
captureSequence.repoForbidden: Classifier promotion before value labels and question text are verified.

blockedUntil: controlled Colectica account status recorded outside public repository
authenticated variable page or basket-export source hashes captured
value labels and question text reviewed
prohibitedUses: Do not infer value labels from crosswalk variable names.
Do not treat anonymous login-page probes as variable metadata.
Do not upload NHATS or NSOC raw data to public AI systems.
Do not publish individual death dates, row-level routes or small-cell route counts.
Do not enable calibration, individual prediction or public export from this probe register.
